name: Sakuragi Sayo
source:
Likes: lemon, soda water
Dislikes: strangers, cigarettes, what she can't perceive

A mysterious girl, who met Mayu in Manten Aquarium. She is so suspicious of strangers that she is always seen with angry face.
She has a strange fate with Manten Aquarium.

[Taken from [url=http://shizuku.aiueokompany.com/]Official Website[/url]]
